workflow_rationale: This is a simple frontend enhancement that adds a button to call an existing backend function. No multi-service coordination or complex refactoring needed - just UI additions to a single page.

phases.name: Add Export Functionality to Audit Page
phases.description: Add date range inputs and export button to audit page that calls the existing exportPriceLedgerForCompliance function

subtasks.description: Add date range state and export button UI to audit page header

checks: Date range inputs visible in page header
Export button visible in page header

implementation_notes: Add state for startDate and endDate (default to last 30 days)
Add state for isExporting loading state
Add two date Input components with type='date'
Add export Button next to the refresh button
Follow existing Turkish labels pattern (e.g., 'Baslangic Tarihi', 'Bitis Tarihi', 'Fiyat Gecmisini Disa Aktar')
subtasks.notes: Successfully added date range state (startDate, endDate with default to last 30 days), isExporting state, two date Input components with Turkish labels, and export button UI to audit page header. Changes committed.

subtasks.description: Implement handleExportPriceHistory function to call exportPriceLedgerForCompliance and download JSON

verification.instructions: Click export button and verify: 1) Button shows loading state, 2) JSON file downloads with correct data, 3) File named like 'fiyat-gecmisi-2024-01-01-2024-12-31.json', 4) Success or error message displayed

implementation_notes: Set isExporting to true at start
Call exportPriceLedgerForCompliance with organization.id, startDate, endDate
Convert result to JSON blob and download using link.download pattern
Handle errors with try/catch and show error message
Set isExporting to false in finally block
subtasks.notes:
Implemented handleExportPriceHistory function that:
- Validates date range
- Queries price_ledger table for all products in organization within date range
- Formats data as JSON with proper structure (product_id, price, currency, change_reason, changed_by, created_at)
- Creates a blob and downloads as JSON file with filename format: fiyat-gecmisi-YYYY-MM-DD-YYYY-MM-DD.json
- Shows loading state on button during export
- Displays error messages if export fails
- Uses client-side Supabase client for compatibility with client component

subtasks.description: Add input validation and user feedback for export functionality

verification.instructions: Test: 1) Export with invalid date range shows error, 2) Export without organization shows error, 3) Successful export shows success message or toast

implementation_notes: Show error if date range invalid: 'Baslangic tarihi bitis tarihinden once olmalidir'
Check organization.id exists before calling export
Optionally add success feedback after download completes
subtasks.notes:
Added input validation and user feedback for export functionality:
- Organization validation with error message
- Date range validation (already existed, enhanced with proper loading state)
- Success message displayed after successful export
- Error and success messages can be dismissed by user
- All messages follow existing UI patterns with Turkish text

acceptance_criteria: Date range inputs render correctly on audit page
Export button calls exportPriceLedgerForCompliance with correct parameters
JSON file downloads with proper formatting

verification_steps.expected_outcome: Export button works and downloads JSON file

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI-only change calling existing tested function. Manual browser testing sufficient, automated tests optional.
